method: Six 30-second excerpts, each taken from the beginning of its source and matched to -23 LUFS. All MIDI samples use the same Salamander piano; the direct-audio baseline supplies its own timbre. Identical 20 ms edge fades; no frequency filtering, denoising or compression.
coverageNote: Two local MIDI models were generated with two predetermined seeds each. The set also includes one existing direct-audio baseline and one authored MIDI reference. The unavailable routes below have no listening sample.
attribution: Piano samples: Salamander Grand Piano V3 by Alexander Holm, CC BY 3.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0/), from https://archive.org/details/SalamanderGrandPianoV3. Rendered with sfizz 1.2.3; mechanical key/pedal noise layers omitted. Listening excerpts cropped, edge-faded and gain-matched.

coverage.name: Aria
coverage.detail: Two piano continuations from one original eight-bar MIDI prompt. The prompt is excluded from both listening excerpts.

coverage.name: Text2midi
coverage.detail: Both outputs ignored the solo-piano instrumentation request. Listening versions omit percussion and play all remaining notes on piano. Raw MIDI is preserved; the reveal identifies the adaptations.

coverage.name: ACE-Step 1.5 turbo
coverage.detail: One existing direct-audio piano attempt. No new ACE-Step generation was run for this set.

coverage.name: Authored MIDI reference
coverage.detail: An original eight-bar phrase written in code, rendered on the common piano. This is a reference, not output from a trained music-generation model.

coverage.name: Salamander Grand Piano V3
coverage.detail: The same real piano sample library renders all MIDI-derived excerpts.

coverage.name: Eleven Music v2.5
coverage.detail: No account or API credentials are available.

coverage.name: Lyria 3.5
coverage.detail: No account or API credentials are available.

coverage.name: Stable Audio 3
coverage.detail: Official Medium and Small Music weights require gated Hugging Face access. Unauthenticated downloads returned 401; no authorized credentials are available.

coverage.name: Pianoteq

samples.label: Aria · continuation 01
samples.description: Model-generated piano notes continuing the original eight-bar MIDI prompt, rendered with Salamander. The authored prompt is excluded.
samples.configuration: Official generative checkpoint; seed 21021; temperature 0.90; min-p 0.035. First 30 seconds of generated-only continuation.

samples.label: Aria · continuation 02
samples.description: A second fixed-seed continuation of the same original MIDI prompt, rendered with the same piano. The authored prompt is excluded.
samples.configuration: Official generative checkpoint; seed 21022; temperature 0.90; min-p 0.035. First 30 seconds of generated-only continuation.

samples.label: Text2midi · piano arrangement 01
samples.description: The original output failed the solo-piano brief: multiple instruments and drums. This arrangement omits 148 percussion notes and plays the 316 pitched notes on Salamander. It is an adapted output, not a successful solo-piano generation.
samples.configuration: Seed 210641; temperature 0.9; 2000 tokens. Requested C major, 64 BPM; original tempo varies around 87–128 BPM. No pitched-note, velocity or tempo corrections.

samples.label: Text2midi · piano arrangement 02
samples.description: The original output also contained multiple instruments and drums. This arrangement omits 76 percussion notes and plays the 396 pitched notes on Salamander. Raw output is preserved separately.
samples.configuration: Seed 210682; temperature 0.9; 2000 tokens. Requested A minor, 68 BPM; original tempo about 67.1 BPM. No pitched-note, velocity or tempo corrections.

samples.label: ACE-Step 1.5 turbo · direct audio baseline
samples.description: An existing direct-audio attempt prompted for gentle solo felt piano. Its timbre is generated directly, without MIDI or the common piano sampler. Retained as a comparison with the earlier route.
samples.configuration: Seed 42022; 8 inference steps; shift 3; language model disabled. First 30 seconds of the original 60-second output; no denoising or frequency shaping.

samples.label: Authored MIDI · reference control
samples.description: The original phrase written in code and used as Aria's input, rendered with the same Salamander piano. This controls for the sound of the renderer; it is not a trained music model's output.
samples.configuration: Eight bars; D major; 64 notes; about 62.7 BPM. First 30 seconds. Note and string-release samples retained; mechanical noise layers omitted uniformly for all MIDI samples.
